name: Parsley Pork Chops with Lemon & Herb Roasted New Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry potatoes, lemon, and parsley. Halve or quarter (depending on their size) the potatoes. Thinly slice the lemons into rounds. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
2.01 kg new potatoes
1 ½ lemon
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Transfer potatoes, lemon slices, and ½ of the parsley and garlic (save the rest for garnishing) to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast, tossing once halfway through, until golden and tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Season pork with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add pork and cook until browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Add water to pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Add remaining parsley and garlic to pan juices.
To serve, arrange pork chops and potatoes on a plate and drizzle with pan juices. Enjoy!
